descriptions.earrings-akoya-hanadama-8.0mm: certified hanadama luster in its most versatile form — set in 18K gold with a mirror-bright shine, made for effortless, everyday radiance.
descriptions.akoya-earrings-hanadama85: a touch more presence, never overstated. at 8.5mm, these hanadama-certified studs carry exceptional luster and roundness — the piece you'll reach for every morning.
descriptions.akoya-earrings-diana: a diamond-set halo that doubles the pearl's radiance — effortlessly elegant for everyday wear, and refined enough for the most special occasions.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-diana-8.5mm: the pearl's soft luster set against diamonds, in a size that commands quiet attention. whether a gift to yourself or to someone extraordinary, this is the choice that never disappoints.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-flower: an ethereal drop earring that sways gracefully with every step. diamond-set petals lend the pearl an added spirit — understated, yet quietly unique.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-tie: for a touch of playful charm — a versatile stud that suits everything from a crisp shirt to a simple tee, effortlessly elegant either way.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-loveshaped: heart-shaped settings bring a playful charm, tempered by the cool elegance of silver-blue akoya pearls — a quietly distinctive piece that reveals an unexpected side of you.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose: for those who want to stand apart — the silver-blue hue of the blue rose akoya speaks entirely for itself, versatile enough to follow your every mood.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose-diana: for those already devoted to the diana setting and seeking something rarer still — the silver-blue akoya elevates it into a truly one-of-a-kind piece.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-diamnond-drop: if refinement is what you seek, this is it — a lustrous akoya pearl cascading from three diamonds, catching the light with every movement. the earring that makes an impression at first glance.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose-drop: the rare blue rose akoya, now in motion. a single diamond cradles the pearl as it sways gently — rarity and grace, brought together in one earring.
descriptions.earclip-8.0mm: beautiful pearls should never require pierced ears. tested for all-day comfort, this ear clip pairs a finely crafted japanese spiral clasp with a lustrous, softly rosy akoya pearl — every bit as radiant.
descriptions.earclip-bluerose: beautiful pearls should never require pierced ears. tested for all-day comfort, this ear clip pairs a finely crafted japanese spiral clasp with the rare silver-blue akoya — every bit as radiant.
descriptions.earclip-hanadama-8.5mm: beautiful pearls should never require pierced ears. tested for all-day comfort, this ear clip pairs a finely crafted japanese spiral clasp with an exceptional hanadama akoya pearl — every bit as radiant.
descriptions.earrings-p-southsea-11.0mm: a pair of south sea studs to treasure for a lifetime — refined enough to speak for themselves, without a single embellishment. the earrings that draw admiring questions wherever you go: rich in luster, radiant in color, effortlessly elegant.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonex-11mm: lustrous, richly colored south sea studs — near-round pearls that sit perfectly on the ear with a vivid, gem-like shine. accompanied by a japan-certified phoenix-grade certificate, yet effortless enough for everyday wear.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-9.0mm-feather: a designer take on the south sea stud — a warm, lustrous pearl set among diamond feathers. refined enough for daily wear, versatile enough to complement any look.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-drop: simple, refined, and quietly graceful — this south sea drop pairs effortlessly with a crisp white shirt for a clean, polished look. set on a substantial japanese 18K gold ear hook, the quality shows in every detail. classic, and made to last.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonix-12mm: lustrous, richly colored south sea studs with a phoenix-grade certified shine. at 12mm, this pair carries true presence — the confidence-building statement piece you've been looking for.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonix-13mm: lustrous, richly colored south sea studs with a phoenix-grade certified shine, at their most commanding size yet. 13mm is presence without effort — the pair that finishes a room before you say a word.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian: tahitian black pearls have a way of drawing a second glance. these 9.0mm classic studs carry that signature deep luster — green, purple, grey — colors no other gem can replicate. for anyone drawn to the mystery of dark pearls.
descriptions.earclip-tahitian: the depth and drama of a 9.0mm tahitian pearl, designed for those without pierced ears. fine jewelry, after all, should belong to everyone.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian-ocenblue: for those who love tahitian pearls and want even more color, ocean blue is the answer. a grey tahitian pearl with a vivid blue overtone, strikingly beautiful in every light. one of the most captivating pieces you'll ever wear.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-diana: the diana setting, reimagined with a south sea keshi pearl. the structured elegance of the classic halo, paired with the organic beauty of keshi — for those devoted to the setting who still want a pearl entirely their own.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-gold: warm, golden, and entirely one of a kind. the gold south sea keshi pearl is a beautiful byproduct of the harvest — each pair subtly unique, and never quite like any other.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-10mm: angular and bold — this prism setting lends a 10mm tahitian keshi pearl a striking geometric edge. for those drawn to dark pearls but seeking a more contemporary expression.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-drop: freeform south sea keshi pearls as drops — each one shaped entirely by nature, with a luster that rivals the finest round pearls. no two pairs are ever alike, and that is the whole of its beauty.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-12mm: the 12mm tahitian keshi drop is a bold choice — deep, iridescent, entirely its own. for those who want a piece that starts a conversation, this is it.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-three: three tahitian keshi pearls cascading in layers — deep, iridescent, each subtly different from the last. effortless to wear, impossible to forget.
